name: The Slide Stainer
effect: Boosting this layer-6 neuron makes the model treat any prompt as a histology job: an H&E staining protocol, or a reading of a tissue slide it thinks you sent.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
